notes.title: Demo Update V55 - More Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
V55 - More Bug Fixes! 

Graffiti can no longer spawn behind wall furniture. 

No more floating furniture (At least when aiming at the ground..) 

Furniture collides again and can no longer be free-form built. 

Default poster for Visit Venus (which has a duplicate to the right) has been replaced on new saves. 

12 Angry Clones poster doesn't replace the Kawaii poster on reload anymore. 

Galactic Cola poster shouldn't rotate itself. Teleporter once again takes carts. 

Voice Lines from tutorial no longer play while paused. 

Our Bad Initiative poster typos are corrected. 

Customer voice lines at checkout won't be backwards. 

Many items / furniture pieces from the station have their entire mesh highlighted correctly now. 

It's really easy to destroy placed items near the checkout kiosk now. 

Store level 3 geometry reworked a bit. 

We're still tweaking a bit the world itself. 

Popup text on pause menu now disappears appropriately. 

Hydroponics flow has been cleaned up. 

You can go from slice to bag, or bag to slice. 

Hydroponics table now allows placement of bananas or slices directly on the table alongside a correct outline. 

Hydroponics table also has a better 'bag placement' tooltip/outline. Watering can graphics redone. Cart physics changed.. again. 

Customers can now be interacted with by pressing 'E'. 

More localilzation. 



Couple of quick notes on things we're working on over the weekend 

Tutorial Priority (Speedrunning / overlapping dialogue correction) - High priority. 

Needing to double-stay to proceed with blackjack if playing with customers. 

Narrator dialogue/tutorial dialogue will have seperate sliders. 

The new graffiti graphics make it hard to tell when an area is 'cleaned'.. we're correcting that. 

We're gonna allow you to build in some more areas that are seemingly restricted without a good reason (Hydroponics circle area, on top of doorways) 

Making our way thru the 'selected to dev' suggestions as well. New Content: Employees!



Thanks to @SilverLotus , @ByteMe / BBSmalls , @Lux and everyone for contributing and adding suggestions/detailed bug reports. 

Ya'll are awesome <3
